setup.text: Toby angles the borrowed crock toward the light, checking it by smell before setting it back down. "Some of it."

option_a.text: The player hands over a small packet of salt. Toby tucks it beside the borrowed crock and nods. "Bakery weight."

option_b.text: The player casts *portion* over the rising dough. Toby watches as the mass settles into even lumps, then resets his count against the new measurements.

option_c.text:
The player glances at the vessel. "That'll hold?"

Toby nods toward the jar. "Some of it."
